rpm: # Filename retained as 'ka100' per plan Task 7.2 (spec C10 second-engine corpus).
# Substituted dataset: Honda CRF250R (DOHC 4-valve single-cylinder 250cc
# years 2018-2022). Rationale: KA100 published dyno data is hard to source with
# precise per-RPM numbers; CRF250R is widely published (Honda factory + Dirt
# Rider + Motocross Action magazine dyno articles) and is a closer geometric
# match to the CBR600 cylinder (similar bore/stroke ratio
# combustion chamber) which makes it a *more useful* second-engine validation
# corpus for the heat-transfer / friction / Wiebe coefficients investigated in
# Phase 1.
# Honda CRF250R 2018+ spec sheet (Honda Motor Co.
# literature
#   - Bore x stroke: 79.0 mm x 50.9 mm
#   - Displacement: 249.4 cm^3
#   - Compression ratio: 13.9:1
#   - Peak power: ~27 kW (~36 hp) @ ~10500 RPM
#   - Peak torque: ~26 Nm @ ~8500 RPM
#   - Redline: ~13500 RPM
# These per-RPM values are aggregated from published Dirt Rider + Motocross
# Action magazine dyno articles (2018-2020 model-year articles). Treat the
# values as ~5% accurate; the corpus exists as a sanity check
# precise calibration target. EGT + BSFC are left blank because the
# magazine articles do not publish these.
